about_the_game:
Create an intricate castle town deep in the forest with the KR Elf Kingdom Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has made another MV/MZ-sized tileset to help you make a town full of magic and beauty. A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets offer up all the tiles you need to make interior and exterior maps fit for elves! Make a castle with towering roof spires and curving staircases, inns with furniture carved from silver, and weapon shops filled with magically-augmented blades!

Gray, brown, and green walls and floors are the perfect starting point for any building your town will need, and you can choose between simple blank and decoratively carved walls and floors to show the importance of the people who live or work there. Show the skill of the craftsmen in the area with stained glass windows filled with green glass and furniture made from swooping curved silver, while keeping the town in touch with nature with lush ivy climbing the walls of the houses and large trees scattered through the town. Let your heroes gain temporary buffs with platefuls of fresh fruit in the inn, or offer a place to rest with draped green cloth and cushions covering most of the floor.

This pack also includes character sprites for fire, doors, and a treasure chest to decorate your maps. Hide silver and emerald treasure chests behind locked stained glass doors, and make sure every room is lit with ethereal flames. Build a city filled with elegant architecture and creeping ivy with the KR Elf Kingdom Tileset!


The Elf Kingdom Tileset Includes:

Ground tiles:

- water
- grass
- dirt
- cobblestone
- plain floors in gray, wood-tone and forest green
- wood floors in the same colors
- leaf-themed floors in the same colors
- grass, ivy, flowers and lilypads
- elegant fences
- tables in silver and wood tone
- and more!

Walls/roofs:

- Walls to match floors, plus a hedge, rock wall, elegant gray walls with stained glass option, and ivy wall. Also includes gray, brown and green shingle roofs.


Also includes:

- Stairs to match floors
- elegant arches/doors
- pillars
- grand staircases in three styles
- lacy silver decorations to stamp on top of buildings
- lots of styles of windows with stained glass and lit versions
- peaked roofs
- elegant furniture and home elements - fireplaces, beds, chairs, tables, bookcases (with and without decor items) clocks
- bathroom fixtures like a tub and faucet, and a fancy throne
- lighting in several styles - floor lamps, wall sconces, and chandelier (lit and unlit)
- hanging clothing and accessories
- armory - bows, crossbows, arrows with stands, quivers, swords and daggers, magic objects, armor, shields, and stands for armor pieces and shields
- curtains, tapestries and cushions
- kitchen goods - stove (plain and decorated/in use), fruit and veggies, bread, plates, glasses and more
- foliage - large and small trees, bushes, hanging vines


Events and Animations:

- fire animation
- treasure chest
- stained glass door (lit, unlit and transparent)


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
